chapter.heading: I Lift My Voice to the LORD(1 Samuel 22:1–5; Psalms 57:1–11)A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
chapter.v:
I cry
aloud to the LORD;I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.

I pour
out my complaint before Him;I reveal my trouble to Him.

Although my
spirit grows faint within me,You know my way.Along the path I travelthey have hidden a snare for me.

Look to
my right and see;no one attends to me.There is no refuge for me;no one cares for my soul.

I cry
to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge,my portion in the land of the living.”

Listen to
my cry,for I am brought quite low.Rescue me from my pursuers,for they are too strong for me.

Free my
soul from prison,that I may praise Your name.The righteous will gather around mebecause of Your goodness to me.
